latestVersion.changelog:
Book-manuscript-writer v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Generates argument-driven book manuscript sections in modular, 800–1000 word units.
- Enforces a five-phase analytical structure for each unit: Opening Claim, Tension, Analytical Development, Conceptual Elevation, and Closure.
- Requires detailed, claim-based outlines before manuscript generation; collaborates with users to develop these if needed.
- Ensures chapters build a rigorous argument arc, with each unit serving an indispensable conceptual role.
- Designed exclusively for theoretical book chapters and essays, not for IMRaD-style academic articles.
